Under RD-3(a) a rider-named stop is not a detour and the whole segment driven to reach it is exempt in full, so its extra km are not refundable; only the waiting-time rule (RD-3(c)) applies to the stop itself. Correct that no RD-4 exemption exists (F14 no incident; F12/F13 band 4 only), but that is moot once RD-3(a) exempts the segment [F4][F12][F13][F14][RD-4][RD-3].
